HPE Intel X710‑DA2 Ethernet 10Gb 2‑port SFP+ Adapter

The HPE 562SFP+ is a dual-port 10Gb Ethernet network adapter featuring the reliable Intel X710 controller, designed for use with HPE ProLiant Gen9 and Gen10 servers. This adapter supports PCI Express Gen3 x8, delivering high bandwidth and low latency for cloud, virtualization, and data center environments.

Equipped with two SFP+ ports, the 562SFP+ enables high-speed fiber or direct attach copper (DAC) connectivity. The adapter supports advanced networking features such as SR-IOV, iSCSI boot, and VMware NetQueue, making it ideal for virtualized workloads and enterprise infrastructures.

Key Features:

  • Model: HPE 562SFP+

  • Controller: Intel X710

  • Interface: PCI Express 3.0 x8

  • Ports: 2 x 10GbE SFP+

  • Speed: 10 Gbps per port (20 Gbps aggregate)

  • Connector Type: SFP+ (supports fiber and DAC cables)

  • Advanced Features:

    • SR-IOV (Single Root I/O Virtualization)

    • iSCSI and FCoE support

    • VLAN tagging and load balancing

    • Jumbo frames, PXE boot

  • Compatibility: Windows Server, Linux, VMware ESXi

  • Form Factor: Low-profile and full-height brackets included

Use Cases:

  • HPE ProLiant DL and ML servers

  • Enterprise data centers

  • High-throughput storage networks

  • Virtualization and cloud platforms

  • High-speed server-to-server communication
